say:2:1423374001:1.text: Orlana? Why are you here? Shouldn't you be teaching?
say:2:1423374001:1.source_cn: 欧罗娜，你不是在给他们上课吗？为什么会在这里……

say:3:1423374002:1.text: Don't tell me you've already quit. Jules and Jamie are going to be so disappointed! I knew they were wrong about you!
say:3:1423374002:1.source_cn: 难道你这么快就放弃了？朱尔和詹米他们会很失望的！哼，我...

say:4:1423374003:1.text: Actually, I came to find you, Sheena. Jamie, Jules, and Leni will all be in class... You should be there too. We're not starting without you!
say:4:1423374003:1.source_cn: 希娜，我是专程来找你，邀请你加入我的课堂的。我的课堂上...

say:5:1423374004:1.text: I don't need your class! I'm fine on my own. I always have been!
say:5:1423374004:1.source_cn: 我不需要跟你上课，我一个人自由自在习惯了！我一个人也能...

say:6:1423374005:1.text: Then I'll respect that. But I want you to know this: I'm not here on a whim.
say:6:1423374005:1.source_cn: 我尊重你的选择，我只是想对你说，我不是出于新鲜感才留在...

say:7:1423374006:1.text: I stayed here for one reason—I want to teach. That's what I really want to do. And I'm not giving up halfway.
say:7:1423374006:1.source_cn: 我留在这里只有一个原因，就是想成为一名老师，因为这是我...

say:8:1423374007:1.text: Do you have something you want to do? If not, maybe you're still searching. I just want to be someone who helps you on that journey.
say:8:1423374007:1.source_cn: 你有自己想做的事吗？如果没有的话，你现在也在寻找它的路...

say:9:1423374008:1.text: I know you're scared... Scared I'll walk away after you start to trust me. So you'd rather not take the first step at all.
say:9:1423374008:1.source_cn: 我知道，你……害怕被抛弃，你害怕把信任交给我不久后我却...

say:10:1423374009:1.text: That's why I need to promise you, and myself, that I won't give up. That I'll help you find what you're good at, so you can choose your own path someday.
say:10:1423374009:1.source_cn: 所以我觉得，我必须向你，也是向我自己作出承诺：我不会轻...

say:12:1423374011:1.text: I... I just want to grow up fast. I want to go to the royal city and find my mom...
say:12:1423374011:1.source_cn: 我……其实，我想快点长大，去王城，找我的妈妈……

say:13:1423374012:1.text: If you trust me, put your hand in mine.
say:13:1423374012:1.source_cn: 如果你愿意相信我，就把你的手搭在我的手上吧。

say:16:1423374014:1.text: You didn't have to say it out loud!
say:16:1423374014:1.source_cn: 你们看到就好，干嘛还要说出来！

say:17:1423374015:1.text: Jules and Jamie must be getting impatient. Let's head back. You've still got a class to teach.
say:17:1423374015:1.source_cn: 朱尔和詹米他们估计都等着急了，我们赶快回去吧。你还要给...
